The same swap preserves the section law, giving equal pair means and the stated formula. With a single active pair the difference is exactly zero; the full product and both types of omissions give the stated values, including the no-zero-coordinate case.

For k≥2 the other-pair sum has positive continuous even density. Centered interval overlaps show closure of even monotonicity under convolution. Its positive tilt is integrable and continuous, hence nonconstant, and the covariance integrand is nonpositive everywhere and negative on a product of two positive-probability intervals. The conditional absolute difference thus has mean strictly between zero and one.

The active coarea support has dimension 2k−1, nonempty relative interior, and exponential decay; scalar dilation yields the exact total active mean 2k−1. Nonnegative pair deficits sum to 1/2. The homogeneous section with all coordinates has dimension d, and its R=1 slice has dimension d−1; the restricted gradient of R is nonzero and constant. For d=1 the affine slice is a single point and the same calculation uses its counting measure.
